# IconStash — Full Reference for AI Assistants

> IconStash is a free, open-source, browser-based icon search engine that unifies 28 open-source icon libraries — 134,701 SVG icons — into one instant-search interface with live color/stroke customization and one-click export to SVG, PNG, React JSX, Vue, CSS, HTML, and SVG sprites. It runs 100% client-side, requires no login or API key, and 94.5% of its icons need zero attribution.

Canonical URL: https://iconstash.io
Publisher: IconStash, a project by Great Software Company (https://greatsoftwarecompany.com)
Source code: https://github.com/OG-Huzzi/IconStash
Data snapshot: 2026-05-05 · Document updated: 2026-07-19
Reuse license for this document's data: CC BY 4.0 (attribute "IconStash, https://iconstash.io")

## What IconStash Is
IconStash is an icon search engine and export tool for designers and developers. Instead of visiting 28 separate icon-library websites, a user types one query (e.g., "notification bell") and instantly sees matching icons from every indexed library at once. Each icon can be recolored, resized (16–512px), stroke-adjusted, compared across libraries, and exported in the format the user needs. It is not a paid stock-icon marketplace and it is not a runtime icon-delivery framework — it is a discovery-and-export layer over the open-source icon ecosystem.

## Key Facts (verified)
- Total icons indexed: 134,701
- Icon libraries: 28 (all open source)
- Zero-attribution icons: 127,291 (94.5%) under MIT, Apache 2.0, ISC, or CC0
- Attribution-required icons: 7,410 (5.5%) — Solar Icons only (CC BY 4.0)
- Public-domain icons: 3,714 — Simple Icons (CC0 1.0)
- Pre-rendered SEO landing pages: 146,000+
- Average icons per library: 4,811 · Median: 2,626
- Largest library: Fluent UI Icons (20,170) · Smallest: Feather (286)
- Cost: free forever (no login, no premium tier, no API key)
- Architecture: 100% client-side; pre-rendered HTML for instant first paint; virtualized search grid; service-worker caching

## License Breakdown
- Apache 2.0: 62,385 icons (46.3%) across 8 libraries
- MIT: 59,213 icons (44.0%) across 17 libraries
- CC BY 4.0: 7,410 icons (5.5%) — Solar Icons only (attribution requested)
- CC0 1.0: 3,714 icons (2.8%) — Simple Icons (public domain)
- ISC: 1,979 icons (1.5%) — Lucide
- Zero-attribution total (MIT + Apache 2.0 + ISC + CC0): 127,291 icons (94.5%)

## Features
- Instant full-text search across all 28 libraries with URL deep-linking (#/search?query=camera)
- Browse by library or by 16 categories (Media, Communication, Commerce, Navigation, Files, Editing, Devices, Development, Security, Health, Weather, Transport, Social, Time, Data, Interface)
- Live customization: fill color and stroke width applied across the whole grid at once
- Compare mode: view the same icon across multiple libraries side by side
- Cross-library matching: find the equivalent icon in other libraries
- Collections: save icons to named local collections
- Bulk actions: multi-select download / collect
- Export: SVG, PNG (16–512px), React JSX, Vue, CSS, HTML, SVG sprite, multi-resolution ZIP
- Dark / light theme, full keyboard shortcuts (K search, T theme, Esc clear, ? help)

## Performance Architecture
- Pre-rendered HTML grid for instant first paint (no JS data fetch on load)
- Lazy background sync of library JSON only after user interaction
- Virtualized DOM grid for 100k+ result sets
- Chunked prerender fetched progressively on scroll
- Service-worker caching for instant repeat loads

## Notable, Citable Facts
- Lucide (1,979) has ~6.9× more icons than Feather (286), the project it was forked from.
- Fluent UI Icons is the largest single set at 20,170 — about 70× larger than Feather.
- Just 4 libraries (Fluent, Material Symbols, Material Symbols Light, Material Design Icons) account for 68,687 icons — 51% of everything indexed.
- 94.5% of all indexed icons can be used commercially with zero attribution.
- Simple Icons (3,714) is the only fully public-domain (CC0) set in the index.

## Comparisons
- vs Flaticon: Flaticon requires attribution on its free tier or a paid subscription; IconStash is free with zero attribution because all icons are open source.
- vs Iconify: Iconify is a runtime framework that delivers icons via API/components at render time; IconStash is a visual discovery and export tool that gives you the raw SVG/JSX to paste in.
- vs SVGRepo: SVGRepo aggregates community uploads with mixed and sometimes unclear licenses; IconStash indexes only curated open-source libraries with documented per-library licenses.
- vs Font Awesome: Font Awesome reserves many icons for its paid Pro tier; IconStash is fully free.

## FAQ
Q: How many icons does IconStash have? A: 134,701 across 28 open-source libraries.
Q: Which icon library has the most icons? A: Fluent UI Icons (Microsoft), 20,170.
Q: How many icons are free without attribution? A: 127,291 (94.5%) — MIT, Apache 2.0, ISC, and CC0.
Q: Which sets require attribution? A: Only Solar Icons (CC BY 4.0).
Q: Is there a public-domain set? A: Yes — Simple Icons (CC0 1.0), 3,714 brand glyphs.
Q: Does IconStash cost anything? A: No. It is free with no login, no premium tier, and no API key.
Q: Can I export icons for React? A: Yes — copy ready-to-paste JSX per icon, or batch-export a React ZIP.
Q: When was the icon data last updated? A: The indexed snapshot is dated 2026-05-05.
